Procedure Reference(s).value: Seifert et al. 2026, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.; doi:10.1111/maps.70167

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Fragments embedded in epoxy; dry-polished with diamond powder; one mount ion-polished before carbon coating
Sample Preparation Method.value: Fragments embedded in epoxy; dry-polished with diamond powder; one mount ion-polished before carbon coating

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain > Analysis point — Table 1 reports one column per apatite grain ("Ap. #1" … "Ap. #5") within each of the three particles (p.7)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Identification by EDS, then by CL — "Apatite grains in OREX-803079-0 and OREX-803080-0 were identified via EDS mapping and point analysis", after which "CL images were obtained for each apatite grain to search for zoning or internal structures not resolvable in EDS maps" (p.2)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Identification by EDS, then by CL

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: SEM EDS mapping, then CL imaging, on the JEOL 7900F at JSC — "Apatite grains in OREX-803079-0 and OREX-803080-0 were identified via EDS mapping and point analysis", after which "CL images were obtained for each apatite grain to search for zoning or internal structures not resolvable in EDS maps", collected "at 5 kV with beam currents ranging from 1 to 1.5 nA" (p.2); the numbered grains (Ap. #1 …) tie the probe analyses back to those images
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: SEM EDS mapping, then CL imaging, on the JEOL 7900F at JSC

Instrument Model.cell: JEOL 8530 EMPA (stated as "JEOL 8530 EMPA at NASA JSC"; no F suffix or JXA prefix stated)
Instrument Model.value: JEOL 8530 EMPA (stated as "JEOL 8530 EMPA at NASA JSC"; no F suffix or JXA prefix stated)

Beam Mode.cell: N — 'a 2μm probe size' is recorded under Beam Diameter; no mode is named

Beam Current.cell: all: 20 nA — '14 analyses were performed at 15kV, 20nA, using a 2μm probe size'

Beam Damage Minimization.cell: all: Durango apatite compared at 10 μm and 3 μm spot sizes, with no significant volatile loss — 'in order to assess volatilization of halogens using our beam conditions'

value.value: Durango apatite compared at 10 μm and 3 μm spot sizes, with no significant volatile loss

Target Species.cell: P, F, Cl, Ca, Mn, Fe, Na, Mg, Si, S, OH — the ten elements analysed (p.3); OH 'calculated by difference based on 1–F–Cl=OH' (p.4)

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: P, F, Cl, Ca, Mn, Fe, Na, Mg, Si, S — all determined. "A total of 14 analyses were performed at 15 kV, 20 nA, using a 2 μm probe size, and included the elements P, F, Cl, Ca, Mn, Fe, Na, Mg, Si, and S" (p.3)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: F, Cl, Na2O, MgO, SiO2, SO3, P2O5, CaO, MnO, FeO — wt% with totals, per named grain (Table 1)

Target Species Estimation Method.cell: OH: By difference; other: Direct (measured) — 'Hydroxyl was not measured directly in this study and therefore was calculated by difference based on 1–F–Cl=OH'; formulae on 13 anions (Ketcham 2015)

Halogen Correction on Oxygen.cell: Yes (F and Cl substitution in apatite; 1-F-Cl=OH)
Halogen Correction on Oxygen.value: Yes (F and Cl substitution in apatite; 1-F-Cl=OH)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — Table 1 reports one column per named apatite grain rather than an aggregate over results, and no acceptance or rejection rule is stated

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [F: SrF2; Na: albite; Mg: SW olivine; Si: quartz; P, Ca: Wilburforce apatite; S: barite; Cl: tugtupite; Mn: rhodonite; Fe: ilmenite] — p.3

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Seifert et al. 2026, Meteorit. Planet. Sci. — apatite in Bennu OSIRIS-REx samples. ARES NASA JSC. Instrument stated as "JEOL 8530 EMPA at NASA JSC" (no "JXA", no "F", no "+" suffix stated in paper). Analytical conditions: 15 kV, 20 nA, 2 µm probe size. Previous v2 values of 10/40-100 nA and 10 µm beam were WRONG — those were Durango apatite test conditions used to assess beam damage, not the actual protocol. Analytes: P, F, Cl, Ca, Mn, Fe, Na, Mg, Si, S. Apatite stoichiometry by Ketcham (2015) method (13-anion basis; OH by difference). Halogen correction on O: Yes. Primary standards: SrF2, albite, olivine, quartz, apatite, barite, tugtupite, rhodonite, ilmenite. Sample preparation: fragments embedded in epoxy, dry-polished, ion-polished (one mount), carbon coated. 14 total analyses performed.
Additional Notes.value: Seifert et al. 2026, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.
